name: Cynet Services
summary: Melbourne business semi-permanent dialup (voice-modem to ISDN; web via Total Network Support, by 1996); merged with SubNet Internet Services c. Jan 1999.

events.details: Business dialup (Cynet Internet Services); earliest cynet.net.au capture Dec 1996.

"Cynet has merged with SubNet Internet Services to form one single ISP" (Jan 1999); cynet.net.au then redirected to sub.net.au (still doing so in 2002). Domain later reused by the unrelated KeyPoint (2003-04).
